solve_least_core_lp: solve the least core LP for a coalitional game using constraint sampling and return player payoffs and epsilon
add_all_constraints: add all coalition constraints to the least core LP for every possible subset of players
make_uniform_sampling_constraints_functi: create a uniform constraint sampling function that randomly selects coalitions for the least core LP
run_least_core_lp_with_all_constraints: run the least core LP solver with all coalition constraints enumerated for small games
run_least_core_lp_with_sampling: run the least core LP solver with uniform random constraint sampling for scalability
